system.summary: Simple substitution of about 21 invented signs (circle, inverted V, 8, q-shape, 2-shape, crossed 4, T, inverted T with hook, bracket, box with two dots, domes with a dot, strokes, curls) for the letters of German; word division kept, hyphens at line ends. One sign carries d and b (or the d and b signs are too alike for the transcribers), one carries h and ch, one u and v. No nomenclator and no homophones seen.
system.notes: Two dots over the box are part of the sign n. Key in key.tsv; frozen copy in heldout/KEY_frozen.tsv.

prior_solution.where: No decipherment on the leaves or in the file (fol. 109-121 seen). No edition or regest of the file's contents found (catalogue vetting of 3 Nov 2026: DECODE, Tomokiyo, Lasry, edition literature); no issue, pull request or target in this repository on Heinsberg before this one.

conditions.human_role: Elke Schwedmann (WGfF, Bezirksgruppe Ruhr) photographed the folder at the archive for the project. AI language-model agents (Claude) transcribed, recovered the key, ran the held-out test, read and reviewed. No human palaeographer checked the text.
models: Claude (Anthropic) agents, Opus, viewing the images

solution.what: Photographs of AA 0582 B 2 fol. 1-74 and 109-121 by Elke Schwedmann (WGfF, Bezirksgruppe Ruhr), 16-17 Nov 2026; the two cipher letters are fol. 120 and 121.
Two blind passes by two independent AI agents, each with its own sign codes and atlas; correspondence of codes in key.tsv.

Preregistration frozen (heldout/PREREG.md, SHA-256) before any key search: letter 1 for training, letter 2 held out. On letter 1 only: frequent short words (und 32x, uns 20x, die, daz, du, wir, mit) gave the substitution by hand; the whole letter read at once.

One measure on letter 2 (held out, both passes) with the key, lexicon and script frozen by SHA-256: lexical coverage S = 0.580 (pass A) and 0.548 (pass B) against at most 0.073 for 200 keys with permuted values. Preregistered outcome: PARTIAL (threshold 0.85 not reached, margin over the controls 0.48-0.51); the low coverage comes from the lexicon (letter 1 vocabulary plus a hand list), since the decryption of letter 2 reads throughout.

Both letters read with every doubtful word marked; strict counts letter 1: 535 sure, 6 probable, 2 restored, 3 unresolved of 546 words (99.1 %); letter 2: 85 sure, 2 probable, 1 unresolved of 88 (98.9 %).

Independent AI reviewer: own decoder from key.tsv reproduces both mechanical decryptions (549/549 and 90/90 words); sentences read against the translations; 12 places checked on the photographs (r02, r10, r16, r22, r24, r27, r36, v01, v02, 121 l. 2, 5, 9). Corrections taken over: r27 'niemt', Korfurst[en] and dat[u]m marked as restored.
Repository issues, pull requests and targets searched for Heinsberg, Russebruck, 1618, ar-776: nothing. Catalogue vetting (3 Nov 2026) found no edition or decipherment.

outcome.method_basis: Substitution recovered from letter 1 by frequent words; frozen and tested on letter 2 (held out).
outcome.fraction_read_source: Strict word counts in reading_120.md and reading_121.md (sure + probable over all words of both letters).

texts.label: Letter 1, fol. 120r-v (48 cipher lines)
texts.summary: To his officer: Krumel's loan. Ask him to wait a month or six weeks, or else take his money and return the letters of debt with a sealed receipt; his letters stipulate Electors' gulden struck before their date, so offer four gulden per hundred as surcharge in other coin; find out what bond the new lenders want, whether Godart von Flodrop will lend for the redemption, and ask the Vogt of Roermond not to press for his money now.

reading_review.by: independent AI language-model agent (Claude, review session)
reading_review.note: Reads as coherent prose over 48 lines about deferring and repaying Krumel's loan (sealed receipt, Electors' gulden, a four-per-hundred surcharge, Godart von Flodrop, the Vogt of Roermond); translation faithful. Doubtful: r18 (two unresolved words), r35-36, v02 phrasing. Own decoder reproduces the decryption 549/549 words; 9 places checked on the photographs; its corrections (r27 niemt, restorations marked) were taken over.

texts.label: Letter 2, fol. 121r (10 lines)
texts.summary: To his officer: come to Aachen on Friday evening or Saturday morning with Hucking the rent-master, the money and the needed letters; tell Krumel to come too; the lord's envoy will be there; keep Heinsberg safe meanwhile.

reading_review.by: independent AI language-model agent (Claude, review session)
reading_review.note: Reads as clean connected prose throughout: the officer is told to come to Aachen with Hucking and the money, bring the needed letters, summon Krumel and keep Heinsberg secure during the absence. Translation is faithful; only 'dame' is unresolved and the rent[m]eister restoration is marked. Own decoder reproduces the decryption 90/90 words.
